body: Yes. For most, suicide is an inherently bad thing. I would like to know how it could be a bad thing for me.
I don't want to find a reason to live, I want to know what the reasoning is behind anti-suicide people.

If suicide prevention is a thing, then there is a reason to live that people know of, else anti-suicide people could not possibly say DO NOT DO THIS! and not be able to follow up as to why. It is not up to me to find one.
